title: CFT octahedral splitting
basic_overview: Six ligands split d orbitals into lower t₂g and higher e_g sets.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Start degenerate. 2. Bring six ligands on axes. 3. Put d(x²−y²),d(z²) higher. 4. Fill with spin rules.
extra_info_content.factors: High/low spin depends on Δo vs pairing energy P.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
